taste:
This sirloin offers rich beef flavour with a firm bite, balanced by tenderness and a juicy centre. The grilled exterior has a caramelised character, giving the steak a contrast between its surface and the meat inside. It is described as grilled to your liking, so stating your preferred doneness is an important part of ordering. Expect a pronounced savoury profile rather than a mild-tasting cut.

Golden chips make the plate hearty, while sweet green peas contrast with the beef. A grilled tomato half and an earthy flat mushroom complete the accompaniments. Together, these give it the character of a classic steakhouse meal, with the steak remaining the main focus.
value:

The sirloin's strongest reason to order is its balance of tenderness and rich beef flavour. [Steak Club](/steak-club) pricing applies on Tuesdays at participating pubs, often with a drink included. Check the local offer and eligible drinks before judging the overall value.
